paper_000.title: GeoH2 model: Geospatial cost optimization of green hydrogen production including storage and transportation
key_findings: Pipeline transport lowest cost in all hexagons
Key cost components: wind/solar, electrolyzer, battery, H2 storage, transport, water

paper_001.title: Green hydrogen production and use in LMICs: Kenya case study

paper_002.title: Estimating cost of capital for renewable energy projects
key_findings: Cost of capital varies widely: developing countries significantly higher than industrialized
Solar PV has lowest CoC, then onshore wind, then offshore wind
CoC can account for 50% of LCOE in developing countries

paper_003.title: Adverse effects of rising interest rates on sustainable energy transitions
key_findings: Rising IR can add 11% (PV) and 25% (wind) to LCOE
Financing costs can account for ~1/3 of total LCOE
Three IR scenarios: flat, moderate, extreme
